meta.title: Dutch with "Offers on Best Price" requires a closing condition

steps.note: Start the required eRFX creation flow for an RFQ that can be converted to a Dutch auction.

args.title: PRD-KBSRC-329 Dutch Best Price Closing Condition

steps.note: Create an RFQ-only event, the prerequisite for conversion to a Dutch auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the minimum product needed to publish the RFQ.
Commit a bidding schedule so the RFQ can be published.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the auction conversion create screen where Dutch-specific options are configured.

args.goal: On the auction conversion screen, select the Dutch strategy, select "Offers on Best Price", and verify that a closing-condition selector appears and is required before publishing; stop with that required selector visible and unfilled.

steps.note: Directly tests the Dutch Offers on Best Price behavior and the resulting required closing-condition control, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the resulting conversion screen has no rendering or application errors.
